name: kondi-slack-mcp
description: MCP server providing Slack Web API tools for messaging, channels, and reactions

tools.name: slack_post_message
tools.description: Post a message to a Slack channel or reply to a thread.

tools.name: slack_get_messages
tools.description: Retrieve recent messages from a Slack channel.

tools.name: slack_get_thread
tools.description: Retrieve all replies in a Slack thread.

tools.name: slack_list_channels
tools.description: List Slack channels the bot has access to.

tools.name: slack_add_reaction
tools.description: Add an emoji reaction to a Slack message.
